description: Land Title Settlement Department - Hiththatiya Central, Matara D/S Division, Matara District - Cad. Map No. 820003 (24/0675)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of specific land parcels, their owners, property boundaries, encumbrances, and legal determinations regarding land ownership. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) classification, and appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette.
